Name: lewd Lance and make love with him (describe the content) SVE
Author: RubyRuvika
Description:
[b]Make Love - Lance SVE Support[/b]📋 Description:
This mod adds [b]Make Love[/b] support for [b]Lance[/b] from [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b]!
Now you can enjoy intimate moments with Lance, complete with custom animations and dialogue.
[line]✨ Features[list]
[*]✅ Custom adult sprite for Lance
[*]✅ Animated scenes compatible with Make Love mechanics
[*]✅ Dialogue in [list]
[*]Anglais (default.json)
[*]Français (fr.json)
[*]Chinese (zh.json)
[*]Korean (ko.json)
[*]German (de.json)
[*]Spanish (es.json)
[/list]
[*]✅ Fully integrated with Make Love's existing system
[*]✅ No conflicts with other mods
[/list]
📦 Requirements
[b]Required Mods:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] (3.17.0 or higher)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16003]Make Love[/url] by Kabulla
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] by FlashShifter
[/list]
🛠️ Installation[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b], [b]Make Love[/b], and [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b]
[*]Download this mod
[*]Unzip the [code][CP] Make Love - Lance SVE[/code] folder into your [code]Mods[/code] folder
[*]Launch the game!
[/list][b]That's it![/b] The mod will automatically be detected by Make Love.
[line]🙂‍↕️ ConfigurationNone required! Just install and play.
Make sure you:
[list]
[*]Have at least [b]8 friendship hearts[/b] with Lance or Victor (configurable in Make Love settings)
[*]Are [b]dating or married[/b] to Lance or Victor (unless disabled in Make Love config
[/list]
🤝 Compatibility✅ [b]Compatible with Polyamory Sweet mods![/b]
[list]
[*][b]Important:[/b] If you use Polyamory Sweet, you must [b]remove or disable the PolyamoryKiss folder[/b] as it conflicts with Make Love animations.
[code]Mods\PolyamorySweet\PolyamoryKiss\ ← Delete this folder
[/code][b][i]Without this step, Make Love won't trigger properly.[/i][/b][/list][line]🎨 Credits[list]
[*][b]Sprite artwork & dialogues[/b]: Ruby
[*][b]Sprite structure[/b]: Based on Make Love by Kabulla
[*][b]Lance character[/b]: Stardew Valley Expanded by FlashShifter
[*][b]Make Love mod[/b]: Kabulla
[/list][line]📝 ChangelogVersion 1.1.0[list]
[*]✨ Added [b]Victor[/b] support for Make Love
[*]🌍 Added [b]4 new languages[/b]: German, Spanish, Chinese, and Korean (for both Lance and Victor)
[*]📝 Updated mod name and description to reflect multi-NPC support
[/list]Version 1.0.0 (Initial Release)[list]
[*]Added Lance support for Make Love
[*]Custom sprite and animations
[*]English and French dialogue
[/list][line]❤️ SupportIf you enjoy this mod, please endorse! It helps other players find it.
For bug reports or suggestions, use the Posts or Bugs section.
[line]
[b]Want support for other SVE characters?[/b] Feel free to request them in the Posts section! I'm open to creating addons for other NPCs like Sophia, Olivia, and more.
